scope: Read-only offline analysis of pinned stock 02.01.01.07; no firmware execution or printer contact

busybox.qualification: Applet-name table and filesystem links are verified in the inspected image; runtime formatting, shell settings and physical transfer remain device acceptance checks.

symbol_recovery.qualification: The tool warns about absolute-looking offsets. The base is its recovered relative-base value, not the first printed _stext address. It was cross-checked against coherent function instructions, branch targets and exact literal strings. These are recovered symbols, not vendor debug information.

trace_observations.operation: sw_uart_probe calls of_alias_get_id with serial, then selects state using alias * 0x1b4
Formats uart%d_port from hardware alias and reads u32 into 0xc0a5874c + alias*0x1b4 + 0xc8; read error takes probe failure branch
sw_console_get_port loops six enabled UART entries; compares field +0xc8 of matching state with console index at +0x2a
sw_console_setup defaults baud to 0x1c200 (115200), bits8, parity n, flow n before optional uart_parse_options
sunxi_pmx_request formats vcc-p%c from bank number and requests ordinary regulator
Bank5/PF plus descriptor byte flag at +0x1c selects optional vcc-pfo regulator request
Enables ordinary and conditionally optional PF regulators
Conditionally calls voltage-dependent sunxi_pinctrl_set_io_bias_cfg; does not expose measured pin voltage

kernel.interpretation: Hardware alias and console index can differ through uartN_port. Embedded UART0 value is empty; a live fixup/mapping is unverified. PF/PFO driver paths do not independently resolve header signal voltage.

uboot.context: bootdelay=0; bootcmd=run sunxi_sprite_test; console=ttyS0,115200; sunxi_sprite_test=sprite_test read
uboot.interpretation: Factory/sprite environment context, not proof of normal Linux console selection

reproduction: Read the SquashFS image without executing any payload; inspect /bin/busybox applet table at the pinned offset and resolve the listed symlinks.
Recover kernel gzip/config as in UART-DT-FOLLOWUP.json; verify plain-kernel hash, recover kallsyms using the pinned tool, and disassemble ARM little-endian bytes at VA minus 0xc0008000.
For function hashes include the range up to the next symbol, including trailing literal pools; do not treat decoded literal-pool words as instructions.
Follow cited branch/call targets and literal pointers to confirm UART/PF observations. Compare embedded FDT properties separately from the unknown live boot-patched tree.
